inputs.name: splitLines.contents
inputs.description: The text to split into lines. Only newline characters separate lines: nothing is trimmed, so a CRLF file keeps a carriage return at the end of each line, and an empty string gives one empty line.

inputs.name: auditFileLength.path
inputs.description: The file path copied into the finding's path field. It is used as given: the function does not read the file or check that the path exists.

inputs.name: auditFileLength.lines
inputs.description: The lines of one file. Only lines.length is read, so every entry counts, including the final empty entry that splitLines produces from a trailing newline, and the text of the entries is never inspected.

inputs.name: auditFileLength.limits
inputs.description: Sets the thresholds for this check, and only maxFileLines is read here. Defaults to harnessRuleLimits, the shared object exported by the explorer-ui catalog, whose maxFileLines is 220.

inputs.name: auditClassCount.path
inputs.description: The file path copied into the finding's path field. It is used as given: the function does not read the file or check that the path exists.

inputs.name: auditClassCount.lines
inputs.description: The lines to scan for class declarations. A line counts only when, after optional leading whitespace, it starts with class or export class followed by a name, so export default class, abstract class and declarations in the middle of a line are not counted.

inputs.name: auditClassCount.limits
inputs.description: Sets the thresholds for this check, and only maxClassesPerFile is read here. Defaults to harnessRuleLimits, the shared object exported by the explorer-ui catalog, whose maxClassesPerFile is 1.

inputs.name: maskTemplateLiterals.contents
inputs.description: The source text to mask. Only backticks are tracked: characters between a backtick and the next unescaped backtick are blanked except newlines, and quotes and comments are not parsed, so a backtick inside either also starts a span.

outputs.name: splitLines
outputs.description: The lines of the input in order, with each newline character removed and any carriage return left in place. A trailing newline gives a final empty string, and an empty input gives one empty line.

outputs.name: auditFileLength
outputs.description: An empty array when lines.length is at most limits.maxFileLines; otherwise one small-file finding with the given path and a message giving the line count and the limit.

examples.message: File has 412 lines. Limit is 220. Split it by responsibility.

outputs.name: auditClassCount
outputs.description: An empty array when the number of counted class lines is at most limits.maxClassesPerFile; otherwise one max-classes-per-file finding with the given path and a message giving the count and the limit.

outputs.name: maskTemplateLiterals
outputs.description: The input with each character between a backtick and the next unescaped backtick replaced by a space, keeping those delimiting backticks and every newline character. Splitting the result on newline characters gives the same number of lines as the input.
